desc: Identify the reduction of minimax path distances to maximum edge weights on MST paths.

Derive a complete correctness proof for the Kruskal DSU balance algorithm, including why each successful union at weight w contributes w times the cancellable opposite surplus and why arbitrary ordering of equal-weight MST edges is safe.
Design Kruskal implementation details: maintain per-root signed A-minus-B multiplicity balance, cancel opposite balances on successful unions, and accumulate 64-bit cost.
Check repeated values, equal-weight edges, zero balances, and answer bounds.
Implement the complete Python stdin/stdout solution with iterative DSU, sorting edges, and output.
